title: I just asked AI, so there's no real development to be done, but
author: Wild-Sport67
selftext:
I just asked AI for help, so it’s not really development, but it’s amazing that a game of this quality was created just by asking AI. Since I spent 1.1 million won, this might be the level of quality, but it’s amazing how literally the idea of being able to make anything becomes a reality. Of course, there’s a lot to fix, but to me, this alone is fascinating. Since it was made only with AI, I think many people might find it unpleasant. But someday I’d like to try making one myself. I want to become a creator. Just to add, I made it using Manus AI. There are no paid subscriptions. I just found it fascinating and wanted to share it.
